perks.summary: +2% damage with melee polearm hits while on foot (halved at sea).
perks.conditions: Attacker on foot (no mount), melee weapon whose relevant skill is Polearm.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the attacker's own CharacterObject, primary (Personal); runs inside CalculateDamage, which RBM keeps

perks.rbm: None. Mission.GetAttackCollisionResults still runs AgentApplyDamageModel.CalculateDamage on RBM's InflictedDamage (bypass map note 8); RBM posture crush-through re-runs it too (MeleeBlowPatch.Math.cs:552).

perks.summary: +2% damage with melee polearm hits while mounted.
perks.conditions: Attacker mounted, melee weapon whose relevant skill is Polearm (land and sea, full value).

perks.summary: +0.25 dismount penetration (ignores 25% of the rider's dismount resistance) when a polearm hit can dismount a rider.
perks.conditions: Melee polearm blow on a mounted human that CanWeaponDismount allows (thrust with a CanDismount weapon, or an on-foot swing with a CanHook weapon), victim survives, not shrugged off. Moot when RBM's couch/brace shortcut fires (polearm_couch / polearm_bracing usage thrust to head/neck/chest/shoulders above the magnitude threshold): that blow always dismounts.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal); called from MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.DecideAgentDismountedByBlow (MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.cs:38)
RBM skip only for strong couch/brace thrusts (forced dismount); every other case falls through to vanilla where the perk counts

perks.rbm: Bypass map #5: conditional skip for couched/braced thrusts above threshold (outcome forced, perk moot); otherwise vanilla.

perks.summary: +0.3 knockback penetration on polearm thrusts against men on foot.
perks.conditions: Active (non-couched) melee polearm thrust with a WideGrip weapon that lacks CanKnockDown, victim a human on foot, not shrugged off. Couched/braced (passive) hits are always knocked down/back by RBM anyway.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal); called from MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.DecideAgentKnockedBackByBlow (MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.cs:69), only for unmounted human victims (Mission.cs:5634)
RBM forces KnockDown on every passive (couched/braced) agent hit and KnockBack on blocked ones; perk irrelevant there

perks.rbm: Knockback decision path is not patched; RBM's CreateMeleeBlow postfix only adds flags for passive attacks.

perks.summary: +5% swing speed while wielding a polearm (halved at sea).
perks.conditions: Wielded melee weapon's relevant skill is Polearm (mounted or on foot).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on agent CharacterObject -> SwingSpeedMultiplier; method not patched

perks.rbm: RBMAI's SetWeaponSkillEffectsOnAgent replacement (AgentStats.cs:421) runs BEFORE the perk step, and the later stamina scaling (AgentStats.cs:317) is multiplicative, so the perk is kept.

perks.summary: +10% damage on melee polearm thrusts (halved at sea).
perks.conditions: Melee polearm hit with StrikeType thrust (includes couched/braced lance hits).

sites.why: captain half (+30 polearm skill to infantry)

perks.summary: +2% combat movement speed while wielding a polearm (halved at sea).
perks.conditions: Wielded weapon's relevant skill is Polearm; affects CombatMaxSpeedMultiplier (combat stance movement).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on agent CharacterObject -> CombatMaxSpeedMultiplier (assigned at :1207)

perks.summary: +0.25 knockdown penetration with knockdown-capable polearms; also raises the knockdown-dismount fallback against riders.
perks.conditions: Melee polearm with the CanKnockDown weapon flag: thrusts always, swings only on a sweet-spot hit (the description says thrusts only). Victim on foot (knockdown) or a rider (DecideAgentDismountedByBlow falls back to DecideWeaponKnockDown). Moot for couched/braced hits, which RBM always knocks down.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal); called from MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.DecideWeaponKnockDown (MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.cs:337)
secondary half is PartyLeader (AddPerkBonusForParty, +3 HP to infantry)

perks.rbm: Knockdown path not patched. RBM's couch/brace dismount shortcut (HorseChanges.MountedCombat.cs:74-87) and passive-attack KnockDown (DamageRework.Blows.cs:39) make it irrelevant for those hits.

perks.summary: +70% damage to horses with melee polearm hits.
perks.conditions: Melee polearm hit whose victim is a mount (land and sea, full value).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal); not gated on foot

perks.rbm: None (damage pipeline intact). Note the StringId is 'PolearmSteadKiller' (TaleWorlds typo), the property is Polearm.SteedKiller.

perks.summary: +20% to the movement-speed bonus of polearm strikes while mounted (swing, thrust and couched lance).
perks.conditions: Attacker mounted, polearm weapon, positive closing speed (extra linear speed > 0 for swing/thrust; couched lance via the vanilla passive path).

sites.why: couched lance; this model method is not patched (RBM only replaces the CombatStatCalculator math it calls)
skipped: RBM's CalculateBaseMeleeBlowMagnitude prefix never calls the model (bypass map #3)
RBM re-implementation for swing/thrust, same mounted+polearm condition; called from MagnitudeChanges.Melee.cs:132 and :237

perks.rbm: Swing/thrust path re-implemented by RBM (MagnitudeChanges.Perks.cs); passive path vanilla.

perks.summary: Couched-lance kills pass through (lance stays couched) 30% of the time instead of 5%.
perks.conditions: Mounted attacker doing a passive (couched) thrust that kills the victim. Land only.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal), base 0.05 + 0.25
RBM overwrites the collision reaction but re-calls the model for passive attacks, so the perk-adjusted roll decides

perks.rbm: Bypass map #16: overwritten but re-implemented (vanilla's roll discarded, RBM's roll includes the perk).

perks.summary: +50% damage on melee polearm hits to the head (halved at sea).
perks.conditions: Melee polearm hit on the Head body part.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal), IsHeadShot = VictimHitBodyPart == Head

perks.summary: Nothing: captain (formation morale) and governor (garrison wages) perk only.
Nothing: party-leader (shield-wall skill bonus) and captain (formation damage) perk only.
Nothing: party-leader perk (party HP, infantry recruit cost).
Nothing: governor (veteran militia) and party-leader (daily XP) perk.
-40% damage taken from horse charges.
perks.conditions: Victim of a horse charge (IsHorseCharge collision). Land only. Code does not check that the victim is on foot.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the victim's CharacterObject, primary (Personal)

perks.rbm: RBM replaces the charge magnitude (ComputeBlowMagnitudeFromHorseCharge, physics only) and ComputeBlowDamage, but charge hits still go through Mission.GetAttackCollisionResults -> CalculateDamage (Mission.cs:6107, :6542), so the reduction applies.

perks.summary: Couched/braced polearm hits that land on a shield get x4 base magnitude (description says triple); RBM's couched-lance caps keep the full x4 only for slow hits, and shrink it to about x1.9 at full gallop.
perks.conditions: Passive (couched or braced) polearm hit blocked by a shield, attacker or victim mounted (vanilla zeroes passive magnitude otherwise). Land only. Not gated on the attacker being mounted, so a braced spear hitting a rider's shield also counts.

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on attacker CharacterObject, primary (Personal); called from MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.ComputeBlowMagnitudeMelee (MissionCombatMechanicsHelper.cs:671), not patched
RBM's shield damage uses the perk-boosted magnitude but snaps couched magnitude to 230 or the ballistic value and caps it at 430 (x ThrustMagnitudeModifier)

perks.rbm: Perk still applies, but RBM's couched-lance clamp (DamageRework.Core.cs:51-84: couched value snapped to 230, or the ballistic value when that is >= 230, capped at 430, x ThrustMagnitudeModifier) makes the gain x4 for low magnitudes, about x2 mid-range and 430/230 = x1.87 for fast charges, before RBM's nonlinear shield-armor damage (estimate from the clamp math, not tested in game).

perks.summary: +15% handling with polearms that can swing, and under RBM posture, about 13% less posture lost when blocking with them.
perks.conditions: Wielded polearm with a swing damage type (SwingDamageType != Invalid). Handling halved at sea.

sites.why: RBM posture: divides block posture cost by the handling bonus (postureEnabled, rbmAi)

perks.rbm: HandlingMultiplier only scaled multiplicatively by stamina (AgentStats.cs:310). RBM adds a posture benefit; that factor is cached per Stance (recomputed on captain/weapon change).

perks.summary: +5% damage on melee polearm thrusts (halved at sea).
perks.conditions: Melee polearm hit with StrikeType thrust.

perks.summary: Per Polearm skill point above 250: +0.2% swing/thrust speed and +0.5% polearm melee damage; most troops are below 250, so they get nothing.
perks.conditions: Troop's own raw Polearm skill (GetSkillValue, not effective skill) above 250. Vanilla troops top out at 260 (+2% speed, +5% damage). Halved at sea.

sites.why: AddEpicPerkBonusForCharacter (secondary, also Personal) -> melee polearm damage

perks.rbm: None; both stat fields only scaled multiplicatively by RBM stamina.
